title: Administración de aplicaciones Android por ADB

supported_operations.label: Desinstalar aplicación instalada por el usuario
Inhabilitar aplicación seleccionada para el usuario Android
Volver a habilitar una aplicación inhabilitada

package_classification.user_installed: Puede ofrecer desinstalación normal si ADB está autorizado.
package_classification.preinstalled_noncritical: Mostrar como posible candidata a inhabilitar para el usuario; no borrar el APK del sistema por defecto.
package_classification.system_critical_or_unknown: Bloquear acción automática; mostrar solo información y recomendar comprobar documentación/modelo.
package_classification.device_owner_or_management_agent: No desactivar ni eliminar; remitir al administrador o procedimiento autorizado del fabricante.
package_classification.security_or_account_protection: No intentar retirar, neutralizar o evadir controles de antirrobo, cuenta, gestión empresarial o financiación.

limitations: ADB cannot override every Android permission, device-owner policy, OEM restriction, or protected package state.
Some preinstalled packages cannot be removed without privileged access; do not escalate or bypass those restrictions.
Disabling a package may break calls, startup, updates, accessibility, payments, or device-specific features.
An app that returns after removal may be restored by an authorized management policy, installer, system update, or another app; diagnose the source instead of repeatedly forcing removal.
Exact package behavior varies by Android version and manufacturer; test model-specific behavior before offering an operation.
